overrides.comment: NFR2: component CSS must reference semantic color tokens, never primitive color tokens directly. Spacing/radius primitives are exempt: they don't vary across the data-theme/data-brand axes the way colors do, so no semantic indirection layer was built for them.
semantic.css intentionally repeats the bare :root selector to group each theming axis (brand/theme/font-family/font-size) into its own readable block; these are not accidental duplicates.
